races.name: Irish EBF Median Sires Series Fillies Maiden
Saudi Cup Silver Flash Stakes (Group 3)

runners_data.name: Alpha
runners_data.note: Trained by A P O'Brien with Ryan Moore aboard, this two-year-old has a win at 7f on Good and a placed effort at 7f on Soft, giving genuine course-and-distance profile; a natural prominent racer who should slot in second or third and is the most dangerous chaser to Blonde Over Blue.

runners_data.name: Alpine Wedding
runners_data.note: Paul Twomey's charge ran just four days ago and that quick turnaround warrants monitoring, though form figures of 5-3 at 7f in similar going suggest she handles conditions; a prominent type likely to press from the front rank if freshness is not an issue.

runners_data.name: Blonde Over Blue
runners_data.note: Joseph Patrick O'Brien's sole confirmed pace-setter arrives off a 49-day break following a winning debut at 7f on Soft; rated to lead throughout, though the STYLE_FIT flag notes she is technically operating slightly out of her most comfortable role and should be assessed on how cleanly she controls the early exchanges.

runners_data.name: Cedrela
runners_data.note: Robson De Aguiar's runner is entirely unexposed with no last-run date and no prior form figures available, making style and going response genuinely unknown; Colin Keane's booking provides some encouragement but the assessment must carry a clear lightly-raced caveat.

runners_data.name: Dancing Destiny
runners_data.note: Holds a solid record of two wins from four starts including victories at 8f on Good, and represents Joseph Patrick O'Brien's second string; her natural instinct is to race prominently, but the crowded forward ranks mean she has been repositioned to midfield on the pace map, which tempers her chance of producing her best.

runners_data.name: Green Empress
runners_data.note: Dylan Browne McMonagle partners this lightly-raced filly who has placed twice from twice at 6f on Good; stepping up to 7½f is the key question, and her style is unverified beyond a pattern of finishing second, but the powerful O'Brien-McMonagle combination elevates her interest.

runners_data.name: Nevermindtherain
runners_data.note: Wayne Lordan rides this A P O'Brien hold-up type who carries headgear and has form figures of 5-5-3, showing modest ability at best; the step up from 5f to 7½f is significant and the back-to-back poor runs make this one to watch cautiously rather than confidently.

runners_data.name: Tosca No Candis
runners_data.note: Robson De Aguiar's second runner is a hold-up type who has finished fifth twice from two starts at 7-8f on Good; trainer's 0-from-12 in the 14-day window offers little support, and without any win or place at this level she needs dramatic improvement to feature.

races.paceDynamic: Blonde Over Blue is the sole confirmed front-runner in this eight-runner field and, with no genuine pace rival to pressure her, she is positioned to dictate a sustainable, controlled gallop over Leopardstown's flat 7½f on Good turf. Alpha and Alpine Wedding are the other prominent types, likely to track just off the leader and keep the tempo honest without forcing a burning early fractions. Dancing Destiny, a natural prominent racer, has been mapped to midfield due to the surplus of forward-going types, meaning the early order may compress slightly as position is negotiated, but this is unlikely to produce a true test of speed from the front. This race shape — a lone leader at a manageable pace with prominent chasers close behind — strongly favours horses who can race in second or third, travel well into the straight, and produce a clean, sustained finish rather than a sharp turn-of-foot from deep.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Blonde Over Blue Dictates
scenarios.trigger: If Blonde Over Blue secures a clean lead unchallenged and controls tempo through a sustainable gallop.
scenarios.body: With no rival prepared to test her early, she can dictate the fractions and produce a kick from the front, making the race a stamina-tinged test of consistency at 7½f on Good ground.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Override
scenarios.trigger: If Alpha or Alpine Wedding press Blonde Over Blue decisively early and force a stronger pace than she sets.
scenarios.body: A contested lead sharpens the tempo and suits horses who travel smoothly in the slipstream before asserting in the final furlong; both Alpha and Alpine Wedding have the class and position to capitalise.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Surge Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses dramatically in the straight, leaving room for the back-markers to reel in tiring leaders.
scenarios.body: Tosca No Candis and Nevermindtherain would need a longer-than-expected gallop to set up a late run, and with a controlled pace likely this is the least natural outcome; neither has yet shown the form to suggest they can bridge the gap.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Midfield Mover Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the race is muddling enough that Dancing Destiny, mapped to midfield, can push through a gap in the straight despite being out of her natural position.
scenarios.body: Racing wide of her preferred prominent berth, she would need traffic to clear quickly and leaders to tire; her form figures at the trip give her an outside chance, but the positional compromise is a meaningful handicap.

watchPoints.text: Blonde Over Blue's ability to get a clean break from the gates is critical — if she is slow away, Alpha or Alpine Wedding could steal a march and the entire pace map shifts.
Alpine Wedding ran just four days ago; monitor in the parade ring for any signs of a quick-turnaround dip in condition, as a below-par performance from her could open up the race shape.

Dancing Destiny's jockey Declan McDonogh will face an early decision — push forward and risk traffic, or settle mid-pack and accept a compromised role; how this is handled could decide whether she is a factor at all.

Green Empress steps up from 6f to 7½f for the first time; if she handles the extra ground her consistent placing pattern and McMonagle partnership make her worth tracking through the first half of the race.

Cedrela is a complete unknown with no published last-run date or form string — Colin Keane's record in similar spots suggests he will not be on a lost cause, so watch her closely in the market moves before post time.

races.name: Japan Racing Association Tyros Stakes (Group 3)

runners_data.name: Aix La Chapelle
runners_data.note: Trained by Aidan O'Brien and ridden by Ryan Moore, this colt has a single run behind him — an impressive win over 7f on Good — giving strong course and going alignment; sits naturally prominent and is ideally placed to track Nail House and pounce in the straight.

runners_data.name: Florida Bay
runners_data.note: Has won over 7f on Good and brings a solid form profile including a recent return to winning ways, but with multiple prominent types in the field this natural front-rank racer will likely be shuffled into a midfield berth it doesn't ideally suit, which tempers confidence slightly.

runners_data.name: Folsom Blues
runners_data.note: Joseph Patrick O'Brien's runner won on soft last time and has only one Good-ground run on record, so the going switch may be worth monitoring; sits comfortably in the prominent group and a return to Good turf over this trip is not a major concern given the form string.

runners_data.name: Nail House
runners_data.note: The lone confirmed front-runner, Joseph Patrick O'Brien-trained, with a debut win over 6f on Good; steps up to 7½f here but the uncontested lead and Good ground are both positives, and J M Sheridan has clear instructions to roll forward.

runners_data.name: Supreme Lord
runners_data.note: Lightly raced with just a single third-place run over 6f on Good and a cold trainer record at 0/12 in the 14-day window; style unknown which adds uncertainty, and stepping up in trip from 6f to 7½f against more exposed rivals is a notable test.

runners_data.name: Tio Joao
runners_data.note: No days-since-last-run data is available and going preference is listed as unknown, which makes this runner the most opaque in the field; mapped to hold-up on redistribution but true style is uncertain, and the absence of form or going information demands significant caution.

races.paceDynamic: Nail House is the lone confirmed front-runner and, with only six runners and no genuine challenger for the lead, is set to control this race from the front at a sustainable, uncontested gallop over 7½f on Good turf at Leopardstown. Aix La Chapelle, Folsom Blues, and Florida Bay are all prominent-running types who will need to settle just off the pace rather than fight for the front, meaning the race will compress early into a tight group behind Nail House with limited positional battles to stretch the tempo. Florida Bay, despite being a natural prominent racer, is mapped to midfield here because there are more pace-committed types than positions at the front, and in this shape Nail House and Aix La Chapelle are the most likely pair to secure the forward berths. A controlled, single-pacemaker setup on Good ground over this trip historically rewards horses who sit close to the leader and travel with cover — the prominent-to-midfield profile benefits most, as Nail House sets an honest but unexaggerated tempo that allows those just behind to time their challenge off a steady sectional rather than a collapse in front.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Nail House Controls, Prominent Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If Nail House dictates an uncontested lead and the race is run at a sustainable clip throughout.
scenarios.body: Nail House sets a controlled tempo from the gates with Aix La Chapelle and Folsom Blues tracking in his wake, setting up a straight-line dash where the winner emerges from the first two or three positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Nail House Leads, Stays On
scenarios.trigger: If Nail House's lead never comes under serious pressure and he holds on into the final furlong.
scenarios.body: Nail House, uncontested and relaxed through the early stages, finds reserves to repel challengers in the closing stages as those behind fail to deliver a decisive surge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closers Emerge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is surprisingly hot early and the front group tie up inside the final furlong.
scenarios.body: Tio Joao or Supreme Lord, racing from further back, could pick up ground if the leaders falter, though both are unknown quantities and this shape relies on a pace collapse that looks unlikely with Nail House uncontested.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse, Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If a positional battle breaks out unexpectedly or an incident disrupts the run of the race.
scenarios.body: Should multiple prominent types jostle aggressively in the early stages, the race could develop untidily and open the door for a hold-up runner to benefit, but with only six runners and clear pace hierarchy this shape is highly unlikely to materialise.

watchPoints.text: Watch Nail House in the stalls and from the gate — if anything disrupts his clean break, the entire race shape changes as Aix La Chapelle or Folsom Blues could inherit the lead and alter the tempo profile entirely.

Florida Bay is a natural prominent racer who may press forward despite being mapped to midfield; if Wayne Lordan elects to go for the front, it could inject unexpected early pressure on Nail House and raise the pace.

Supreme Lord's unknown style and light experience over the longer 7½f trip makes it a wildcard — watch how Donagh O'Connor positions it in the early stages, as unusual placement could distort the running order.

Tio Joao carries the most uncertainty in the field with no last-run data and unknown going preference — monitor its pre-race vibes and market movement as any market support would be significant given the information void.

Ryan Moore on Aix La Chapelle is the standout jockey booking and worth tracking through the race — Moore's positioning instincts on a prominent-style horse in a six-runner race where he can dictate his own fate will be a key visual cue.

races.name: Dublin To Bahrain Race Series Handicap

runners_data.name: Apercu
runners_data.note: A consistent performer at this trip and going combination (11 runs on similar ground, 3 wins and 3 places), Willie Lee partnering for A. Oliver; the prominent style is legitimate and ideally suited to the expected race shape here; blinkered, which should help early focus.

runners_data.name: Kilcrea Rock
runners_data.note: Fresh off a 58-day break for Joseph O'Brien with Dylan Browne McMonagle booked — that jockey upgrade is notable; has placed in good company over this trip on Good ground and a prominent position at this track suits his profile well.

runners_data.name: Glyndwr
runners_data.note: A genuine hold-up type for Gerard O'Leary whose recent form includes two wins on Tapeta and a return to Good turf is untested in recent runs; 14 days since last run and needs the prominent group to run each other into the ground for Ben Coen to have a clear passage from the rear.

runners_data.name: Dark Viper
runners_data.note: Shane Foley partners for Harrington on a horse whose natural inclination is to race prominently, but the crowded map means he is very likely to find himself shuffled back into an unnatural midfield berth; blinkers fitted, and his best Good-ground form is over shorter; STYLE_FIT discount applies.

runners_data.name: Manton Bay
runners_data.note: Three-year-old for David Marnane with Luke McAteer; placed over 10f on Good ground and has course form at this trip; will be pressing for the prominent positions and the early jostling is a genuine risk for a lightly-raced youngster.

runners_data.name: Wild Sapphire
runners_data.note: Dermot Weld's mare won over 8f on Good and is a naturally quick-away type, but the surplus of prominent runners means she is likely to be outpaced for position early and race in a role that is not her strongest; STYLE_FIT discount applies; only 9 days since last run.

runners_data.name: Harmani
runners_data.note: Colin Keane takes the ride for G.M. Lyons and this three-year-old won over 10f on Good ground in sharp style last time; sits in a legitimate prominent position in the map and Keane's positional judgement could be decisive if the pace is controlled.

runners_data.name: Eastern Peace
runners_data.note: True hold-up horse with Patrick McGettigan (5lb claimer) aboard for Ross O'Sullivan; has placed over this trip and the claim helps with the weight, but his record on Good turf is patchy and he needs a stronger pace than Mr Ballynonty is likely to set to produce his best late run.

runners_data.name: Mr Ballynonty
runners_data.note: The sole confirmed front-runner, trained and ridden by Andrew Slattery, who knows this horse's needs intimately; three runs only with form figures of 3-8-5 and has not won, but the lone lead here on Good ground over 1m1f gives him a tactical opportunity that his rivals in this race cannot easily counteract; headgear (p=pacifier) worn.

races.paceDynamic: Mr Ballynonty is the lone confirmed front-runner and, with trainer-jockey Andrew Slattery likely to use that natural role, he should lead from the gates and set a measured, uncontested gallop over this 1m1f trip on Good ground. Behind him, Apercu, Kilcrea Rock, Manton Bay, and Harmani all want prominent positions, creating a congested battle for the four or five seats directly behind the leader that is likely to see niggling and shuffling two to three furlongs out. Dark Viper and Wild Sapphire are genuine prominent-racing types who are unlikely to secure their natural position in this crowded map and will find themselves racing further back than ideal, compromising their chances. With a single uncontested pace-setter likely to produce a controlled, even tempo on Good ground, this race shape strongly favours horses who can sit close to the pace in a legitimate prominent position and quicken from there — hold-up horses face a secondary disadvantage because the pace will not be searching enough to set up a late surge, and the redistributed prominent types are also compromised.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace, Prominent Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Mr Ballynonty leads at a sustainable clip and the prominent runners behind him settle into rhythm without early scrimmaging.
scenarios.body: Mr Ballynonty's uncontested lead sets a moderate, even pace that plays directly into the hands of horses travelling close behind him, allowing the best horse in a prominent position to pick him off in the final furlong on Good ground.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Scrimmage Breaks Race Open
scenarios.trigger: If the four prominent-seeking runners — Apercu, Kilcrea Rock, Manton Bay, Harmani — fight vigorously for position early and burn each other out.
scenarios.body: A chaotic early section elevates the pace beyond a sustainable level, meaning the horses who survive the scramble are not necessarily the strongest, and a fresher horse from slightly further back can pounce.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Holds On Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Mr Ballynonty steals an unnoticed margin and the pursuing pack fails to coordinate a challenge until too late.
scenarios.body: The modest pace from out front, combined with the traffic problems in the chasing pack two furlongs out, allows Mr Ballynonty to dictate terms so thoroughly that he is not caught before the line.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses in a genuine sprint finish and a hold-up horse threads through beaten rivals in the closing stages.
scenarios.body: Glyndwr or Eastern Peace, racing off a true hold-up position, benefit only if the early contest between prominent runners is genuinely severe enough to leave them all weakening — a less likely outcome at an even Good-ground tempo.

watchPoints.text: Watch the break from the gates closely — Apercu, Kilcrea Rock, Manton Bay, and Harmani will all attempt to press Mr Ballynonty immediately, and a collision or severe crowding in the first two furlongs could unsettle multiple runners and distort the race shape entirely.

Dark Viper and Wild Sapphire are both natural prominent types likely to find themselves squeezed back into midfield; if either forces their way into their preferred position through traffic, the complexion of the pace changes and the race becomes markedly more competitive up front.

Monitor Mr Ballynonty's sectionals through the first half-mile — if Slattery is allowed to dictate at a crawl, the winner is almost certainly in the prominent group at the top of the home straight and hold-up horses become irrelevant.

Dylan Browne McMonagle's booking for Kilcrea Rock is the standout jockey move in the race; a horse returning from 58 days off with that level of tactical rider is worth tracking through the early stages to see how quickly he settles into his position.

Eastern Peace's 5lb claimer McGettigan reduces the burden meaningfully on a horse that has already won over this trip and distance from a hold-up position, but the pace needs to be faster than expected for that advantage to materialise.

races.name: Dubai Racing Carnival Rated Race

runners_data.name: Wyman
runners_data.note: Won last time at 10f on Good and has course-distance form working in his favour; Shane Foley knows the track well and the prominent tracking role here is a natural fit, making this step to 1m5f a logical progression for Mrs Harrington's lightly-raced three-year-old.

runners_data.name: Handshake
runners_data.note: Joseph O'Brien's sole winner in this assignment, rated 120 and a clear class standout, but the 174-day layoff is the overriding concern — McMonagle can use that class advantage to control the race from the front, though a first run back rarely sees a horse at its sharpest, particularly over this stamina test.

runners_data.name: Keepsgettingbetter
runners_data.note: Donnacha O'Brien's three-year-old arrives on a consistent run of form at 10-12f on Good and Standard ground, but despite being a genuine front-running or prominent type by inclination, the presence of Handshake means Gavin Ryan will likely be squeezed into a chasing role he is less comfortable in, which the style-fit flag reflects.

runners_data.name: Lord Aus
runners_data.note: Murtagh's hold-up horse has winning form at 12f on Good ground and arrives 43 days fresh with blinkers noted; the concern is that an uncontested pace set by Handshake will be too moderate for Lord Aus to produce his characteristic late finish in a four-runner field.

races.paceDynamic: Handshake is the sole confirmed front-runner in this four-runner field and, with no genuine rival to challenge for the lead, Dylan Browne McMonagle can dictate a controlled, measured gallop from the front over 1m5f on Good turf at Leopardstown. Keepsgettingbetter is a natural prominent type who has been redistributed to midfield on the map because Handshake will almost certainly occupy the front position unchallenged; in practice Keepsgettingbetter may push forward but is unlikely to unsettle Handshake's rhythm. Wyman should slot into a prominent tracking role behind the leader, while Lord Aus will settle last under Ben Coen, needing a strong enough tempo to be set up for a late run — a tempo that a lone, uncontested leader is unlikely to provide. This race shape strongly favours the prominent stalking profile: a horse that can sit just behind Handshake's comfortable lead, conserve energy through a likely moderate gallop, and have enough left to quicken in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Handshake Controls Unchallenged
scenarios.trigger: If Handshake bowls along comfortably in front with no rival applying pressure, setting a smooth, regulated gallop throughout.
scenarios.body: McMonagle can manage fractions to suit, arriving at the home turn with a full tank and kicking clear before closers can organise; the Good ground poses no concern and the step up to 1m5f on debut is the only query.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Stalker Pounces Late Straight
scenarios.trigger: If Handshake's front-running is slightly too ambitious on the clock and the tracking horse gets a perfect tow into contention.
scenarios.body: Wyman, racing prominently throughout, is delivered to challenge inside the final two furlongs and Handshake's long layoff of 174 days leaves him short of a peak run; Shane Foley on Wyman can time the challenge to perfection.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Finishes Through
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely stronger than expected and Lord Aus gets a true test at 1m5f to unleash his closing run.
scenarios.body: Lord Aus's best form is over 12f on Good ground and a true gallop would unlock his one-paced but relentless staying finish; Ben Coen would need to resist going too early from the back of such a small field.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse, Keepsgettingbetter
scenarios.trigger: If Handshake underperforms badly after a 174-day absence and the race falls apart, allowing a prominent challenger to fill the void.
scenarios.body: Keepsgettingbetter, a genuine prominent type forced into a midfield role by the map, could push forward and take advantage of a disorganised pace scenario; however its lower OR of 79 and the style-fit discount make this a low-probability outcome.

watchPoints.text: Handshake's 174-day layoff is a tangible risk — watch for any signs of ring-rustiness or greenness in the preliminaries that might undermine his ability to front-run effectively.

Keepsgettingbetter may attempt to challenge Handshake for the lead early; if Gavin Ryan pushes forward regardless, it could briefly lift the tempo before one of them capitulates and disrupts the expected shape.
Lord Aus needs a genuinely strong gallop to deliver his closing run in a four-runner field — watch the early sectionals to judge whether the pace is generous enough to set him up.

Wyman is the only runner whose natural prominent-tracking style perfectly maps to the expected race shape; monitor his position in the opening furlongs to see whether Foley secures the ideal spot just behind Handshake.

races.name: Turkish Jockey Club Handicap

runners_data.name: Friary Road
runners_data.note: The race's only confirmed pace-setter and rated OR 72, she has a course-and-distance win in her last five and handles Good going well; Sam Coen's 5lb claim is an asset, and with no rival likely to pressure her for the lead she can control the fractions — her STYLE_FIT tag as a prominent racer leading from the front here is actually a positive, not a concern.

runners_data.name: Trubshaw
runners_data.note: Won at 14f on Good going for Henry De Bromhead but has been off 60 days and his last two runs at 14f+ were modest; Gabriella Hill's 7lb claim helps the weight burden but the layoff and recent form (80 last two) require a bounce-back on seasonal return.

runners_data.name: Party Dress
runners_data.note: A genuine hold-up performer for Willie McCreery who has run only 8 days ago — she stays further than today's 1m7f on paper but her best recent form has come over shorter trips in conditions softer than Good; will need the pace to lift if she is to get into this from the rear.

runners_data.name: Tatum
runners_data.note: Noel Meade's five-year-old is versatile enough to race prominently and ran well last time over 17f on Good ground, finishing third; Paddy Harnett's 5lb claim is useful and his form figures of 21-753 show he has been competitive at this level, making him a natural danger if he gets the right position.

runners_data.name: Jr Mahon
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who was just 3 days ago and ran over 18f at Leopardstown in his recent history — he has struggled for consistency (8/18/14 in recent starts) and his heavy-ground preference noted in his headgear/going flags is a negative on today's Good turf.

runners_data.name: Jurality
runners_data.note: Perhaps the most interesting profile in the race — five consistent runs in the form string including 532125, with a win at 13f and multiple placings at 13-16f on Good going; races prominently, handles this trip and surface well, and Leigh Roche is an experienced handler of this type of horse over staying trips.

runners_data.name: Miss Gitana
runners_data.note: Fades in the finish according to her flags, and her true style is hold-up despite being mapped to midfield due to redistribution — her form reads 6-0980 which is uninspiring, and the controlled pace that Friary Road will set is the last thing she needs if she is to reverse that trend.

runners_data.name: Stone Rulya
runners_data.note: A hold-up type who has faded in finishes and whose best Going sim (6/10) is less solid than most rivals here; Wesley Joyce's 3lb claim helps but her form of 6008-4 over 12-22f shows no convincing win or place strike-rate on this surface, and a slow pace is deeply unhelpful.

runners_data.name: Folly Beach
runners_data.note: An eight-year-old veteran for M A Molloy who is a genuine rear-runner pushed into midfield on the map because of overcrowding at the back of the field; her form of 4-7208 with no wins or places in recent Good-ground runs, and the STYLE_FIT discount, makes her an unlikely beneficiary unless the race is truly run to suit closers.

races.paceDynamic: Friary Road is the lone confirmed front-runner here and, with no genuine challenger for the lead, should dictate at a sustainable, measured gallop over this 1m7f trip on Good turf at Leopardstown. Trubshaw, Tatum, and Jurality will press for prominent positions behind, meaning the early order is likely to settle quickly with Friary Road controlling the tempo from a comfortable vantage point. The absence of true pace pressure means this race will be run at an even, controlled tempo — a shape that strongly favours horses who can race close to or on the pace and sustain their effort through the long Leopardstown straight, rather than those relying on a late surge off a truly searching gallop. Miss Gitana and Folly Beach are genuine hold-up types that have been redistributed into midfield on the map because true rear positions are overcrowded — in practice, Friary Road and Jurality are best placed to actually secure their natural positions, while the hold-up contingent will find this controlled tempo offering them little acceleration to latch onto late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Friary Road Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Friary Road is allowed to stride on uncontested and the pack fails to close the gap turning in.
scenarios.body: Friary Road settles into a rhythm with no one willing to challenge, and the controlled pace suits those racing prominently behind; Jurality, with a strong recent form string including a win and multiple placings at this sort of trip, is ideally placed to pick up the scraps.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Racer Runs Down Leader
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is just strong enough that Friary Road weakens in the final furlong and a pressing horse reels her in.
scenarios.body: Jurality or Tatum, sitting a length or two off the pace in a prominent position, times a challenge to catch a tiring Friary Road close home; Jurality's consistent recent form at distances around 13-16f on Good ground makes this the most credible stalking threat.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Storms Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely strong enough to string the field out and one of the rear-runners finds a clear run late.
scenarios.body: Stone Rulya or Party Dress, racing further back than their position on the map, would need a truly punishing gallop to set up a late charge — the controlled pace forecast makes this a low-probability outcome for true closers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses, Slow-Burn Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Friary Road sets an unusually sedate tempo that causes bunching and an unpredictable sprint finish in the final two furlongs.
scenarios.body: In a messy, compressed finish, any of the prominent or midfield runners could get involved, but this scenario most benefits Tatum, who has the profile to quicken off a slow pace having won a similar race from just off the speed.

watchPoints.text: Friary Road's unchallenged lead — if Sam Coen rolls along at a comfortable gallop and no one commits to closing, she could steal an uncontested win; watch how quickly she is allowed to stride away in the opening half-mile.

Jurality's position at the start — Leigh Roche will want to slot in directly behind Friary Road, and if Tatum or Trubshaw also push forward, a minor jostle for second place could unsettle the early order and briefly lift the pace.

Jr Mahon ran just 3 days ago, which is a sharp turnaround for a handicapper at this level; if the horse is not fully recovered, it could stop quickly in the straight and cause interference for horses attempting to come through.

Stone Rulya and Miss Gitana, both flagged as faders, are worth monitoring in the final two furlongs — if either weakens abruptly in the straight it narrows the passage for any hold-up horses attempting a late run on the inside.

The consistent Good going across all seven Leopardstown races today suggests the ground will ride as advertised and no late bias is expected, keeping the race shape largely as the pace map projects — prominent racers should hold their advantage to the line.
